pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Bequest? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bequest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Bequest has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Bequest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bequest.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Islamic Law? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Islamic Law.
   B. Use Administration of Islamic Law to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Administration of Islamic Law with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Administration of Islamic Law has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected chapter Surah Yusuf.
   C. Use Selected chapter Surah Yusuf to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected chapter Surah Yusuf has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Principles of handling disagreements in Islam has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Principles of handling disagreements in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of handling disagreements in Islam.
   D. Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   C. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Say Science of Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Qur’an.
   D. Use Science of Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

10. Which response best shows understanding of Inheritance? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Inheritance has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Inheritance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inheritance.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic values? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Islamic values has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic values.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Hadith.
   B. Say Science of Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Science of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Science of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Principles of handling disagreements in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Care for the elderly and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. C — Apply the teaching of Administration of Islamic Law with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

9. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

10. A — Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Science of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Care for the elderly; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic values; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prohibitions in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
